'''Jordan Berg''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2002 Columbia Heights tournament]] on 10 August 2002 with EBO, according to Ivan Gribov's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3915">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-08-17-ghetto-heights-minnesota-8-10-02d3915/ ghetto-heights-minnesota-8-10-02], DeckTech (Ivan "Executor96" Gribov, 17 August 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-08-17-ghetto-heights-minnesota-8-10-02d3915/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
